hints.title: Minimum Energy Enemy
hints.text: To maximize point gain, always spend energy attacking the enemy with the absolute minimum energy value.

hints.title: Energy Absorption
hints.text: If initial energy is strictly less than min(enemyEnergies), no points can ever be earned; return 0.

hints.title: Total Resource Pool
hints.text: Absorb energy from all enemies except the minimum. Total points = (currentEnergy + sum of others) // min(enemyEnergies).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass finding min and sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual point and energy exchanges takes O(total_energy) leading to TLE.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that the cheapest enemy should be attacked repeatedly while all others are harvested for energy.
